groupList.tipText:
Your path has never wavered ever since you set foot on this ship.
Your witnesses are the days and nights, as well as the footprints you leave behind.
The path is long, but you will walk resolute.

You have seen the many corners of this land with Rhodes Island.
Witness, explore, and struggle. Changes happen because of you.
The course of Rhodes Island remains yours to chart.

All those moments innumerable, everyone uniquely precious.
You have experienced much, gained much, and lost much.
You did not realize the path was so winding and treacherous until you took a look behind you.
Here and now, though, we still have hopes, we still have dreams, and we still have tomorrow.

constData.detailDesc:
<color=#ffffff>Cumulative Sign-In Rules</color>
Players can accumulate login days through the daily sign-in. When the total reaches a <color=#00C8FF>certain number</color>, and the <color=#00C8FF>Doctor is Lv. 80</color>, you can obtain the corresponding reward.

<color=#ffffff>Sign-In Refresh Rules </color>
Every morning<color=#00C8FF> 04:00 - 03:59 the next day,</color> logging into the game will automatically complete your daily sign in.
